+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _mask_email(email: str) -> str:
+    local, sep, domain = email.partition("@")
+    if len(local) > 1:
+        local = local[0] + "*" * (len(local) - 1)
+    return local + sep + domain
+
+
+def handle_masked_email(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, {"masked": _mask_email(user["email"])}
